outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of an H&E histology image and spatial transcriptomics heatmap overlays, not a plot of averaged data with error bars or summary statistics; individual data points are not applicable.
Panel B shows representative H&E and RNAscope fluorescence micrographs, not a quantitative plot of averaged data; individual data points are not applicable.

Panel C is a scatter plot showing each individual patient tumor's TMPRSS11B expression value (dots) for LUAD (n=512) and LUSC (n=500), with median and 95% CI overlaid. Individual data points are clearly displayed.
Panel D is a bar plot showing mean ± SD, but the individual data points for each of the n=3 replicates per group are overlaid as dots on top of the bars, satisfying the requirement.
